ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 90%) across the primary surface area, with a sharp contrast to a low-intensity black border (approx. 10%) along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white field across the interior of both lobes. A thin, low-intensity black band follows the entire trailing edge. Sparse, low-contrast yellowish-tan circular blobs are distributed across the central and lateral regions of the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 12-15 pixels from the adjacent lobe horizons.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely serrated boundary characterized by high-frequency micro-peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) interspersed with irregular, larger scalloped indentations along the full length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-slanting linear trajectories from the median notch, terminating in rounded, heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, dark, granular pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, exhibiting a textured, non-uniform morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal grey-toned linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark, irregular, textured masses on the terminal tips of both lobes, suggesting extensive scarring or parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Low-saturation yellowish-brown surface mottling patches distributed across the white ventral field, most visible on the left-central lobe.
